title: arrest-ecg-timing: timing bias and machine-read findings in ECG prediction of cardiac arrest (Nightingale arrest-ntuh-ecg)
description: Analysis code for a matched case-control replication on the Nightingale Open Science arrest-ntuh-ecg dataset. A published design that predicted cardiac arrest of any cause from ECGs recorded up to a year earlier is rebuilt; matching cases and controls on the recording gap brings that signal near chance. A one-dimensional CNN is compared with simple signal features and with the ECG machine's own reading under within-set permutation nulls and matched-set bootstrap. Data are not included; logs hold aggregate results only.
